instances.claim: This tells me that the work consists of a defined, bounded collection of individual pieces called Cents, each one of which undergoes the same five-stage life.
instances.why: "Every Cent" quantifies over a fixed membership of artwork units, but nothing before line 11 introduces that collection: lines 5–6 establish the Lincoln cent as a mass-produced coin (five hundred billion of them), which is a kind of object, not the artist's set, and the bounded set of ten thousand only arrives six lines later at 17. The five-part list in 12–16 then elaborates a population the draft has not yet constituted, so the quantifier reads as settled fact while pointing at nothing in the piece.
